title: How Trumpism Survives
author: Rory Bahadur
content:
Image by Colin Lloyd No matter how much evidence accumulates, we cannot reason
our way out of Trumpism if we keep misunderstanding what gives it power. The
people most alarmed by Donald Trump have spent nearly a decade exposing
hypocrisy, cataloging misconduct, correcting falsehoods, and waiting for
enough proof to finally break the spell. But […]
